description: Defines the HpackEntryDecoder class for decoding HPACK entries in HTTP/2 headers, including state management and decoding methods.

classes.name: HpackEntryDecoder
classes.description: Decodes a single HPACK header entry or table size update in a resumable manner, managing decoding state and errors.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins decoding a header entry from the decode buffer, requires non-empty buffer.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Continues decoding if previous decoding was in progress.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the decoder's current state.

methods.name: OutputDebugString
methods.description: Outputs debug information to a stream.

methods.name: DispatchOnType
methods.description: Handles actions based on the decoded entry type.
